title: Luigi's company attacked, court demand for Lazar communications

tellings.quote: To to zero and we were attacked. Nobody knows this, but we were attacked ferociously for over a year and a half.

plain: A businessman known as Luigi, based in Montreal, says that in the 2020s his company was attacked ferociously for more than a year and a half, nearly dropping to zero. He says nobody knows this, and he points to a court document demanding his communications with Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien spacecraft. He tells it as a sign of the pressure that came from being linked to Lazar.
